question: Should `@openclaw/retry` become part of the plugin-SDK-visible workspace package graph, or should retry consolidation remain internal to core and memory-host boundaries?
rationale: The branch wires the package through plugin-SDK declarations and alias infrastructure, making its ownership and compatibility status a product/API choice rather than a purely mechanical refactor.

options.title: Approve shared package
options.body: Keep the package in the plugin-SDK build graph and require compatibility plus real migrated-path proof before merge.

options.title: Keep retry internal
options.body: Remove plugin-SDK package exposure and restrict the shared implementation to internal workspace consumers until an external contract is explicitly needed.

recommendation.title: Approve shared package
recommendation.body: Keep the package in the plugin-SDK build graph and require compatibility plus real migrated-path proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current core Retry-After invariant and are the strongest evidence-backed routing candidate available for the retry contract.
